moments.title: The Hundred Season Nears its Climax
moments.blurb: The Hundred 2026 cricket tournament is in full swing, with daily matches leading up to the men's and women's finals on Sunday, August 16th at Lord's.

angles.name: Live Match Buzz
angles.copy: The Hundred is serving up double-headers today! Catch MI London vs Trent Rockets and Southern Brave vs Manchester Super Giants. Who are you backing?

angles.name: Finals Anticipation
angles.copy: The countdown to The Hundred finals is on! With the big deciders at Lord's on August 16th, which teams are looking like champions?

angles.name: Welsh Fire Update
angles.copy: Our very own Welsh Fire are battling it out in The Hundred! Tomorrow they face Sunrisers Leeds. Get behind them!

moments.title: Aston Villa in UEFA Super Cup Showdown
moments.blurb: English club Aston Villa, winners of the Europa League, will face Champions League holders Paris Saint-Germain in the UEFA Super Cup on Wednesday, August 12th in Salzburg, Austria.

angles.name: Big Game Ahead
angles.copy: Aston Villa go head-to-head with PSG in the UEFA Super Cup this Wednesday! Can they bring another European trophy home? #AVFC

angles.name: UK vs Europe
angles.copy: It's the ultimate club clash: Europa League winners Aston Villa take on Champions League giants PSG on August 12th. Who's got this?

moments.title: Community Shield Heads to Cardiff
moments.blurb: The FA Community Shield, featuring Premier League champions Arsenal and FA Cup winners Manchester City, will be played at Principality Stadium in Cardiff on Sunday, August 16th.

angles.name: Cardiff Hosts Big Game
angles.copy: Huge news for Welsh football fans! The Community Shield clash between Arsenal and Man City is at Principality Stadium this Sunday. Who's going?

angles.name: Premier League Warm-Up
angles.copy: The Premier League season kicks off on August 21st, but the Community Shield in Cardiff on Sunday is the perfect curtain-raiser. City or Arsenal?

moments.title: Sam Fender & Olivia Dean Make Chart History
moments.blurb: Sam Fender and Olivia Dean's 'Rein Me In' has made UK chart history, becoming the longest-running number-one single of all time with 19 non-consecutive weeks at the top.

angles.name: Record Breakers
angles.copy: History made! Sam Fender and Olivia Dean's 'Rein Me In' is officially the UK's longest-running No.1 single ever. What a tune!

angles.name: Chart Toppers
angles.copy: 19 weeks at number one for Sam Fender & Olivia Dean! 'Rein Me In' is still dominating the Official Singles Chart. Have you heard it?

moments.title: UK Braces for Summer Heatwave
moments.blurb: London and parts of the UK are expecting a heatwave this week, with temperatures potentially reaching 32C between August 8th and 15th.

angles.name: Heatwave Incoming
angles.copy: Another heatwave is on the way for London and much of the UK! Stay cool and hydrated as temperatures climb towards 32C this week.

angles.name: Summer Sunshine
angles.copy: Sunny skies and warm temperatures are expected across the UK this weekend and into next week. Perfect weather for those still on summer holidays!

moments.title: Happy 65th to U2's The Edge
moments.blurb: David Howell Evans, better known as The Edge, the iconic guitarist for U2, celebrates his 65th birthday today. He was born on August 8, 1961.

angles.name: Guitar Legend Turns 65
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 65th birthday to U2's legendary guitarist, The Edge! What's your favourite U2 riff?

angles.name: U2 Icon
angles.copy: From 'With or Without You' to 'Vertigo', The Edge's guitar work is unmistakable. Celebrating his 65th today!

moments.title: Happy 49th to Linkin Park's Mike Shinoda
moments.blurb: Mike Shinoda, co-founder, vocalist, rhythm guitarist, keyboardist, and primary songwriter for Linkin Park, turns 49 tomorrow, August 9th. He was born in 1977.

angles.name: Linkin Park Legend
angles.copy: Tomorrow, Linkin Park's incredibly talented Mike Shinoda turns 49! What's your go-to Linkin Park track?

moments.title: Happy 68th to the Queen of Pop, Madonna
moments.blurb: The one and only Madonna, the best-selling female artist of all time, will celebrate her 68th birthday on Sunday, August 16th. She was born in 1958.

angles.name: Queen of Pop's Birthday
angles.copy: Get ready to celebrate! The iconic Madonna turns 68 this Sunday, August 16th. What's your ultimate Madonna anthem?

angles.name: Global Superstar
angles.copy: From 'Like a Virgin' to 'Vogue', Madonna has redefined pop music for decades. Happy 68th to the Material Girl this weekend!

moments.title: The Roots Picnic Lands in London
moments.blurb: The globally celebrated hip-hop festival, The Roots Picnic, makes its international debut in the UK today and tomorrow (August 8-9) at Crystal Palace Bowl, London.

angles.name: Hip Hop Festival Live
angles.copy: It's happening! The Roots Picnic brings its unique blend of music and culture to Crystal Palace Bowl, London today and tomorrow. Who's there?

angles.name: London's New Festival
angles.copy: The Roots Picnic is making waves in London this weekend! Two days of world-class hip-hop and good vibes at Crystal Palace Bowl.

moments.title: Hollywood Vampires & Jimmy Eat World at Cardiff Castle
moments.blurb: Cardiff Castle hosts two major gigs next week: Hollywood Vampires on August 14th and Jimmy Eat World (celebrating 'Bleed American' 25th Anniversary) on August 15th, both sold out.

angles.name: Rocking Cardiff Castle
angles.copy: Cardiff Castle is set for a huge week! Hollywood Vampires on Friday and Jimmy Eat World's 'Bleed American' 25th Anniversary on Saturday. Who got tickets?

angles.name: Jimmy Eat World Anniversary
angles.copy: Relive 'Bleed American' as Jimmy Eat World hit Cardiff Castle this Saturday! An iconic album turning 25.

moments.title: Cardiff Hosts Country Day Party
moments.blurb: A Country Day Party is taking over Circuit Cardiff this afternoon, blending club energy with country chart-toppers for a vibrant atmosphere.

angles.name: Cardiff Hoedown Today
angles.copy: Yeehaw! The Country Day Party is happening at Circuit Cardiff this afternoon. Get ready for modern country hits and a lively atmosphere!

moments.title: Jazz on the Quay Continues in Exeter
moments.blurb: Exeter's popular 'Jazz on the Quay' series continues tomorrow, Sunday August 9th, and next Sunday, August 16th, featuring local bands in the Transit Shed.

angles.name: Sunday Jazz Vibes
angles.copy: Fancy some chilled-out tunes? Jazz on the Quay is back tomorrow in Exeter, with local bands playing in the Transit Shed. Perfect Sunday afternoon!

angles.name: Free Music Exeter
angles.copy: Don't miss the free Jazz on the Quay series in Exeter, happening every Sunday in August. A great way to enjoy local talent!

moments.title: New Star Wars: Visions Series on Disney+
moments.blurb: Star Wars: Visions Presents – The Ninth Jedi, a new limited series continuing the story of 'The Ninth Jedi' short, premiered on Disney+ UK on August 5th.

angles.name: New Star Wars Dropped
angles.copy: The Force is strong on Disney+! 'Star Wars: Visions Presents – The Ninth Jedi' premiered this week. Have you started watching?

moments.title: BritBox Adds New UK Dramas and True Crime
moments.blurb: BritBox UK has a fresh lineup this week, including 'Good Ship Murder' (Aug 5), 'Killing Eve' S3/S4 (Aug 6), 'Dying for Revenge' (Aug 8), and 'Granite Harbour' S2 (Aug 15).

angles.name: New BritBox Binge
angles.copy: Your next binge-watch is ready! BritBox just added 'Dying for Revenge' today, plus 'Good Ship Murder' and 'Killing Eve' S3/S4 this week. What are you watching first?

angles.name: Crime Drama Fix
angles.copy: Get ready for more Scottish crime! 'Granite Harbour' Season 2 drops on BritBox on August 15th. Perfect for a weekend watch.

moments.title: Reading & Leeds, Creamfields Build Anticipation
moments.blurb: Major UK festivals Reading & Leeds and Creamfields are just weeks away, both set for August 27-30, with huge lineups causing a buzz among fans.

angles.name: Festival Countdown
angles.copy: The summer festival season is peaking! Who's excited for Reading & Leeds and Creamfields at the end of August? Lineups are stacked!

angles.name: Big Names, Big Stages
angles.copy: From Charli XCX at Reading to Calvin Harris at Creamfields, August is ending with a bang! Are your festival outfits ready?
